snippet: About Foundry Coffee Co. - Foundry Coffee Co. was founded in 2015 by two software engineers who believed great code deserves great coffee. We roast all our beans in-house at our Seattle headquarters and ship fresh to all our locations. Our mission: brew exceptional coffee while building a welcoming community. We operate 12 locations across the Pacific Northwest.

Our Coffee Sourcing - Foundry Coffee Co. partners directly with small-scale farmers in Ethiopia, Colombia, Guatemala, and Indonesia. All beans are single-origin, ethically sourced, and Fair Trade certified. We visit each farm annually and pay 30% above Fair Trade minimums. Our head roaster Alex Chen has 15 years of specialty coffee experience.

Sustainability Commitment - Foundry Coffee Co. is carbon-neutral since 2022. We use 100% compostable cups and packaging, partner with local composting services, run all locations on renewable energy, and plant one tree for every 10 bags of coffee sold. We have planted over 200,000 trees to date. Our waste diversion rate is 94% across all locations.

Store Hours - All Foundry Coffee Co. locations are open Monday to Friday 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Saturday 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM, and Sunday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Holiday hours vary — check the Foundry app or our website for specific holiday schedules. Some downtown locations have extended hours until 10:00 PM on weekdays.

Location Finder - Foundry Coffee Co. has 12 locations across Seattle, Portland, and Vancouver BC. Use our app or website to find the nearest location, check live wait times, and pre-order for pickup. Drive-through is available at 4 suburban locations. All locations offer free Wi-Fi and have ample seating.

Foundry Rewards Program - Earn 1 point per $1 spent. Redeem 100 points for a free drink (up to $7 value) or 50 points for a free pastry (up to $4 value). Gold status (500 points/year) unlocks free size upgrades, birthday drinks, and early access to seasonal menus. Download the Foundry app to track points and order ahead.

Foundry Rewards - How to Earn Bonus Points - Double points every Tuesday. Triple points on your birthday month. Earn 50 bonus points for trying a new seasonal drink. Earn 200 points for referring a friend who makes their first purchase. Corporate accounts earn 1.5x points on all orders.

Foundry Rewards - Gift Cards - Foundry gift cards are available in $10, $25, $50, and $100 denominations in-store or on our website. Physical and digital gift cards accepted at all locations. Gift card balance never expires. Gift card purchases do not earn reward points but purchases made with gift cards do earn points.

Satisfaction Guarantee - Not happy with your drink? We'll remake it. If your drink was made incorrectly or you're dissatisfied with the quality, let us know at the counter within 10 minutes and we'll remake it at no charge. For app orders, report an issue through the app within 30 minutes for a full refund or store credit.

Allergen Information - Our kitchens handle milk, eggs, wheat, soy, tree nuts, and peanuts. Cross-contamination is possible. We cannot guarantee allergen-free preparation. All menu items have full allergen listings in our app and on in-store menus. Please inform our baristas of any allergies before ordering. We offer dairy-free milk alternatives: oat, almond, soy, and coconut.

Mobile Ordering Policy - App orders can be placed up to 60 minutes in advance. Orders are prepared 5 minutes before your selected pickup time. You can modify or cancel an order up to 10 minutes before prep starts. Late cancellations receive store credit, not refunds. App orders skip the queue — go directly to the pickup counter.

Catering & Corporate Orders - Foundry Coffee Co. offers catering for events of 10 or more people. We provide coffee bar setups, carafes, boxed lunches, and pastry platters. Minimum order $150. 48-hour notice required. Corporate accounts get 15% off catering orders. Contact catering@foundrycoffee.com or call 1-800-FOUNDRY. Available within 20 miles of any store location.

FAQ: Can I customize my drink? Yes! All drinks can be customized. Common customizations include: milk type (dairy, oat, almond, soy, coconut), sweetener level (0, 1/2, 1, 1.5, 2 pumps), temperature (hot, iced, extra hot, extra cold), size (small 12oz, medium 16oz, large 20oz), and extra shots. Customizations may incur small additional charges.

FAQ: Do you have decaf options? Yes. All espresso-based drinks are available in decaf. We use Swiss Water Process decaf beans. Ask for decaf when ordering. We also offer herbal teas which are naturally caffeine-free. Our cold brew is not available in decaf due to the brewing process.

FAQ: Do you have a loyalty program? Yes, the Foundry Rewards program. Earn 1 point per $1 spent. 100 points = free drink, 50 points = free pastry. Sign up free in the Foundry app (iOS and Android). Points expire after 12 months of account inactivity. There is no fee to join.

FAQ: Is your coffee organic? Some of our single-origin offerings are USDA Organic certified — look for the organic label on our seasonal specials board. Our year-round house blends are Fair Trade but not certified organic. All beans are pesticide-tested by our sourcing partners.

FAQ: Do you offer WiFi? Yes, free WiFi at all locations. Network name: Foundry_Guest. No password required. WiFi is provided as a courtesy — please be considerate of other customers during peak hours (7–9 AM and 12–2 PM). Some locations have designated laptop-free zones during weekends.

Seasonal Offerings - Foundry Coffee Co. releases new seasonal drinks and food items every quarter. Spring features floral and citrus flavors. Summer brings cold brew specials and fruit-forward drinks. Autumn is our most popular season with pumpkin, apple, and spice offerings. Winter features warming spices, peppermint, and our signature holiday blend. Sign up for our newsletter to be notified first.

Careers at Foundry Coffee Co. - We're always looking for passionate people. Open roles: baristas, shift supervisors, roasting technicians, and corporate positions. Benefits include health insurance (full-time), free drinks during shifts, 50% off beans, and paid training. Apply at foundrycoffee.com/careers or ask in-store for a paper application. We promote from within — 80% of managers started as baristas.

Contact Foundry Coffee Co. - Customer support: support@foundrycoffee.com or 1-800-FOUNDRY (1-800-368-6379). Catering: catering@foundrycoffee.com. Press inquiries: pr@foundrycoffee.com. Headquarters: 123 Roast Ave, Seattle WA 98101. Social media: @FoundryCoffee on Instagram, Twitter/X, and TikTok. App support: help.foundrycoffee.com.
